scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js --kill-others --names contracts,frontend,backend,node "npm run dev -w @agent/contracts" "npm run dev -w @agent/agent-frontend" "npm run dev -w @agent/agent-backend" "npm run dev -w @agent/node-agent"
scripts.dev:node: npm run build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/node-agent/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/agent-backend/src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @agent/agent-backend && npm run build -w @agent/node-agent && npm run build -w @agent/agent-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
